capture_rule: For every frame containing the P04 Geometry Cache: pose, tick/decode, re-pose the same time, then capture.

frames.name: s4_first
frames.expect: total darkness; no P04 or hangar light leakage

frames.name: arrival_land
frames.expect: total darkness at the former land beat

frames.name: old_glide_start
frames.expect: entry camera remains; no glide cut

frames.name: hard_cut
frames.expect: Klara nested camera; her own dark opening; curtain hidden

frames.name: hard_cut_plus_1
frames.expect: same Klara shot; no one-frame flash

frames.name: klara_pullback_curtain_crossing
frames.expect: no raised curtain in her camera path

frames.name: klara_rest_pose
frames.expect: no curtain and no P04 light leakage

frames.name: klara_last
frames.expect: Klara sequence still owns the image

pie_acceptance: Run uninterrupted from the final 2 seconds of P04 through S4 frame 406.
Repeat by rehearsal jump to S4 frame 405 to expose Geometry Cache decode/stale-frame behavior.
Confirm P04 attachments and S4 hangar practicals contribute zero light before the cut.
Confirm the Klara cut has no unresolved-camera fallback and no one-frame flash.
Confirm the P04 backcloth remains hidden through Klara's pullback and does not reappear before the exit cut.
